changes.header: -- Exact existing postgres NEW-creator equivalence; canonical bodies/other-role revocations unchanged.
changes.pre_guard:
-- BEGIN FINITE NEW-CREATOR PROFILE 131
DO $creator_pre$ BEGIN
 IF current_user<>'postgres' OR session_user<>current_user
  OR current_setting('custodial.deployment_project_ref',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'rqquvtjdmugpigbndmne'
  OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND NOT rolsuper AND rolbypassrls)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory'::regclass AND relowner='postgres'::regrole)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory'::regclass
   AND tgname='trg_custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory_immutable' AND tgenabled='A')
  OR to_regclass('pg_temp.custodial_creator_acl_131_before') IS NOT NULL
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations']::text[]) x WHERE to_regclass(x) IS NOT NULL)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND proname=ANY(ARRAY['static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_input','static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_packet','static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_current','static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_descriptor','static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_guard','static_weekly_stage_vacancy_reviewed_preparation','static_weekly_read_vacancy_reviewed_preparation','static_weekly_consume_vacancy_reviewed_preparation']::text[]))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.custodial_release_authority_restore_inventory i
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT regexp_replace(i.object_identity,'[[:space:]"]','','g') identity) clean
   WHERE (i.object_kind IN('function','grant') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_input','static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_packet','static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_current','static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_descriptor','static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_guard','static_weekly_stage_vacancy_reviewed_preparation','static_weekly_read_vacancy_reviewed_preparation','static_weekly_consume_vacancy_reviewed_preparation']::text[]) name
    WHERE split_part(clean.identity,'(',1)=ANY(ARRAY[name,'public.'||name])))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['public.static_weekly_vacancy_reviewed_preparations']::text[]) relation
     WHERE starts_with(clean.identity,relation) OR starts_with(clean.identity,substr(relation,8)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Finite creator Source131 original owner/new-object boundary changed';
 END IF;
END $creator_pre$;
CREATE TEMP TABLE custodial_creator_acl_131_before(class text NOT NULL,signature text PRIMARY KEY,object_oid oid NOT NULL,owner_oid oid NOT NULL,owner_acl jsonb NOT NULL,definition_md5 text) ON COMMIT DROP;
-- END FINITE NEW-CREATOR PROFILE 131
